criticalPathArithmetic.conclusion: e2e-tests remains the long pole. web and worker shards run fully parallel and finish ~84s before e2e does. Any vitest-level micro-optimisation on those shards buys zero wall-clock until that slack is consumed. This is why no test-level diff is proposed this week.

evidence: 09-14 web shard: 'Failed to save: Unable to reserve cache with key Linux-X64-node24-turbo-ci-59cd482d9c8b11cd, another job may be creating this cache.'
09-11 worker shard: '##[warning]Failed to save: Unable to reserve cache with key pnpm-lockfile-verified-Linux-x64-a04c9791... ' - the pnpm lockfile cache hits it too, at warning level
turboCacheReservationRace.whyNoDiff: The fix would live in .github/workflows/**, which this workflow is forbidden to edit even temporarily.
